title: allamanda cathartica var. hendersonii
intro: Allamanda cathartica var. hendersonii, commonly known as Henderson's Allamanda, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is a tropical plant native to the Pacific Islands, known for its bright yellow, trumpet-shaped flowers and medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Henderson's Allamanda include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as acting as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-histaminic agent.
